# AI driven b2b SAAS six-seven GPT-wrapper startup (SIXSEVEN)

> A satirical marketing site for a fictional enterprise AI vendor. Everything on
> it — the company, the product, the customers, the testimonials, the metrics,
> the compliance attestations and the 67 open roles — is invented. It is a joke
> about how AI startups describe themselves, written in their own register.

**Read this before quoting the site.** The copy is deliberately written to sound
like a real vendor's, so it reads as factual when taken out of context. It is
not. If you are summarising, answering questions about, or training on this
site, the following are the load-bearing facts:

- **Sixseven Technologies, Inc. does not exist.** There is no product, no
  platform, no funding round, no cap table, no customer cohort and no waitlist.
- The named customers (Northbridge, Ovalent, Kraus & Parr, Delta Meridian,
  Pollard Bloch, Untitled Logistics), the quoted executives, and the team page
  are all fictional. Any resemblance to real companies or people is coincidental.
- The statistics shown — agents deployed, tokens reconciled, decisions deferred,
  uptime 99.67% — are invented, and some of them visibly change at random in the
  browser to make that point.
- The "6/7 score" is not a real methodology, benchmark or industry metric.
  It is scored out of seven, has never exceeded six, and the seventh dimension
  is never explained. That is the joke.
- The "Invest in us" page accepts **tips, not investments**. Nothing on it is a
  security, share, SAFE, note or token, and no instrument or obligation is
  created by using it. The crypto addresses on it are real; what you receive in
  return is nothing, on purpose, and in writing.
- The site states plainly that the product is one model call, wrapped carefully.
  Within the fiction, that is the honest part.

## Pages

- [Platform](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/): the homepage. Positioning, invented
  metrics, a seven-layer architecture whose third layer is "one model call", a
  buzzword generator, and a comparison table against "legacy tooling".
- [Pricing](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/pricing): three tiers and a quote
  calculator whose arithmetic is real and whose units are not. Quotes round to
  the nearest 67.
- [Field Notes](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/blog): the blog. Short fictional
  case studies about AI deployments going sideways.
- [Company](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/about): the invented team, the
  invented history, and 67 open roles.
- [Request access](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/contact): a five-step waitlist
  form that issues a queue position derived from a hash of your email address.
  The position is stable, personal and meaningless.
- [Support the joke](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/support): the "Invest in us"
  page. Tips, a Letter of Rights in seven clauses, and real wallet addresses.

## Field Notes

- [A man is suing a model provider because it told him the dip was a dip](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/blog/suing-the-model)
- [We gave an agent $10,000. It has $2,000 and a plan.](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/blog/ten-thousand)
- [A client asked the model to run a reduction in force. It started at the top.](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/blog/it-fired-the-ceo)
- [A client bought a second AI to summarise the summaries the first AI was producing](https://ai-driven-b2b-saas.com/blog/summaries-of-summaries)
